_description: Sample test payloads for Client Intake Automation. Use these to test your workflow.

test_qualified_lead._comment: This lead should score 8+ and route to 'qualified'. Use this to test the happy path.
test_qualified_lead.message: We need to automate our lead intake process. Currently spending 15 hours per week on manual data entry. Looking for a solution that integrates with our HubSpot CRM.

test_nurture_lead._comment: This lead should score 4-6 and route to 'nurture'. Use this to test the nurture path.

test_disqualified_lead._comment: This lead should score 0-3 and route to 'disqualified'. Use this to test the disqualified path.
test_disqualified_lead.message: Just curious about what you do

test_minimal_lead._comment: Minimal data - only email. Tests data normalization and handling of missing fields.

test_full_name_only._comment: Tests name splitting when only fullName is provided.
test_full_name_only.name: John Alexander Smith

test_messy_phone._comment: Tests phone number cleaning with various formats.

test_high_budget_keywords._comment: Tests budget parsing with text-based budget ranges.

test_duplicate_prevention._comment: Send this twice with the same email to test duplicate handling. Second submission should update, not create new.

test_alternative_field_names._comment: Tests handling of alternative field name conventions.
